name: SEO audit (pro)
description: Full SEO health check: which SEO plugin is live, sitemap reachable, per-post title/description quality on the most important pages, and fixes applied only where the owner asked.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many published posts/pages to audit, newest first.

steps.title: Identify the SEO stack
steps.detail: Call wp_list_seo_plugins and report which plugin is active (Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress) and any conflicts.

steps.title: Check the sitemap
steps.detail: Call wp_read_sitemap and confirm it renders and contains the main content types. Note anything missing for the report.

steps.title: Audit the newest posts
steps.detail: Call wp_list_posts (status=publish, per_page=<limit>), then wp_audit_post_seo for each. Summarize missing titles, missing meta descriptions, thin content and duplicate titles.

steps.title: Fix what was agreed
steps.detail: For posts the owner asked to fix, call wp_set_post_seo with improved titles/descriptions. Draft-quality suggestions first; never invent facts.

steps.title: Settings sanity
steps.detail: Call wp_get_settings and verify blog_public is enabled (the site is not discouraging search engines).

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver a summary: issues found, issues fixed, issues left for the owner, with post ids and titles.

guardrails: wp_set_post_seo rewrites live metadata: confirm the list of posts with the owner before bulk fixes.
Never fabricate keywords: only use terms actually present in the content.
